titles.title: Ngôi Sao Nhà Bên Làm Tôi Say Đắm
The Neighbor Star Who Bewitched Me
The Star Next Door Who Bewitched Me

description:
Lim Su-Jeong, a 27-year-old fashion magazine editor, has a special affection for her self-reliant life. She doesn't just find being alone comfortable—she prefers it. Finding reassurance in what she can control, she never considered fitting ‘romance’ into her life. She simply adored and loved SS Boys' Kang Chan, a celebrity with the perfect distance, as her ultimate favorite. Then, like a bolt from the blue, dating rumors about ‘Kang Chan’ hit Su-Jeong, who was going about her usual routine. And the woman involved was none other than ‘Sa-Ra’, a female celebrity constantly embroiled in scandals. After a grueling day in every way, she came home to find Kang Chan's merchandise scattered everywhere. Feeling overwhelmed about when she'd ever clean it all up, she heard the sound of piano music from the apartment above. Today, she absolutely couldn't take it anymore!!! With a “I'll kill you and then kill myself!!!” mindset, she ran up and pounded on the door of apartment 502 above.

 *“Seriously, playing piano late at night is not okay..?!”*

Creak. The door opened cautiously, and out stepped... Sa-Ra?! *“Wow, seriously... she's so freaking pretty.”*

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
